text.zh_CN: 闭门研判会的灯光有些暗。屏幕上的五项宏观压力指数已经连续三周位于极端过热区间。高收益债信用利差压到了历史最低点，隔夜回购市场数次出现非正常流动性脉冲。灰犀牛已经走到眼前了。
text.en: The macro symposium room is dim. Five distinct systemic stress gauges have hovered in extreme overheating territory for three straight weeks. High-yield credit spreads are pinned at record compressed tights, while repo lines saw abnormal liquidity spikes. The gray rhino is already at the door.

text.zh_CN: 每次牛市见顶前都有人在喊崩盘。盘面资金还在买入，这时候用股指期货做套保，每月展期基差和保证金就要损耗近 1.5%。如果市场没崩，这笔对冲费用就是白烧，排名会被对手超过。
text.en: Someone always calls a crash at every bull-market top. The tape is still printing buys. Hedging with index futures costs us nearly 1.5% a month in roll basis and margin carry. If the market doesn't crash, that's money burned, and rivals will pass us in the rankings.

text.zh_CN: 对冲不是为了证明你能预知未来。它的价值在于：当危机真正爆发时，你手里还有筹码，能从容做出选择。暴风雨前的保险往往最贵，但也最救命。远望一期的防线，你打算怎么划？
text.en: Hedging isn't about predicting the future. Its value is that when the crisis hits, you still have chips and can choose calmly. Insurance before a storm is expensive, but it can save you. How do you draw Farview Fund's line of defense?

text.zh_CN: 面对系统性宏观异动，制定对冲比率：
text.en: Establish index futures hedging ratio against systemic macro signals:

text.zh_CN: 利用股指期货进行 100% 充分套期保值，甘愿牺牲基差成本。
text.en: Implement 100% full hedge via index futures, willingly absorbing basis drag.

toast.zh_CN: 宏观防线：已建立 100% 股指期货全额对冲

text.zh_CN: 对冲 50% 核心风险敞口，兼顾下行防守与潜在反弹。
text.en: Deploy 50% partial hedge; balance downside buffer against upside participation.

toast.zh_CN: 宏观防线：已建立 50% 核心敞口对冲

text.zh_CN: 不对冲任何敞口，坚信牛市动能，追求最大净值爆发力。
text.en: Zero hedging; bet fully on prevailing momentum for peak return.

toast.zh_CN: 宏观防线：拒绝避险，裸露全部多头头寸
toast.en: Perimeter: Zero hedge, full unhedged exposure

text.zh_CN: 净值可能走得慢一些，但真到风暴来时，这艘船不会因为一次巨浪就散架。你给委托人留了最实在的一层保护。
text.en: The NAV may grind forward under friction, but when the storm hits, this vessel won't break apart on a single wave. You've given your investors a real layer of protection.

text.zh_CN: 经典的机构妥协艺术。在不确定性的迷雾中，不把筹码押在任何一个极端。你为组合保留了反弹的生机，也留出了防守的余地。
text.en: Classic institutional pragmatism. In the fog of uncertainty, refusing to bet your life on any single extreme. You preserve upside elasticity while reserving shelter.

text.zh_CN: 痛快！这才是真正交易员的气魄！把油门踩到底，那些懦夫瞻前顾后的成本，都将变成我们登顶领奖台的踏脚石！
text.en: Exhilarating! That is the steel of a true trader! Floor the gas pedal; every penny those cowards bleed on insurance becomes fuel for our ascent to the podium!

text.zh_CN: 去期货交易台核对你的空头持仓与保证金占用。风暴前夜的空气总是令人窒息，但明天开盘后，一切狂妄与审慎都会见分晓。
text.en: Audit your futures contracts and collateral usage on the Futures screen. The air on the eve of a hurricane is always stifling. Tomorrow morning, every swagger and every prudence will meet its reckoning.
